lessons_used: Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact in early rounds, but underestimated gains in winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
home wait_info changes are helpful, backed by 2 agreeing winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing early tests, though round 4 yielded a winning test.
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign as its 3 tests do not agree (one won, one showed no clear effect, and one performed worse).
Evidence remains thin for finish new_screen as its 2 tests do not agree (one was rolled back due to guardrail limits, one showed no clear effect).
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, choose_path layout, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, finish new_flow, home notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test so far.

lessons_next: Predictions tended to overestimate positive impact overall (especially in rounds 1, 2, and 5), but underestimated gains in winning tests during rounds 3 and 4.
home wait_info changes can be helpful, backed by 2 agreeing winning tests in rounds 3 and 4.
sign_in hint changes mostly show no clear effect across 3 agreeing tests (rounds 1, 2, and 5), despite yielding one winning test in round 4.
choose_path layout changes showed no clear effect across 2 agreeing tests (rounds 1 and 5).
Evidence remains thin for adoption redesign and finish new_screen because their respective tests do not agree.
Evidence is still thin for choose_path copy, choose_path new_flow, finish copy, finish new_flow, home notification, and sign_in reorder, as each has only one test so far.
